_note: Oldest-end sweep batch 39: 18-22 December 2025. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord wants them to have a prayer group and that they will keep growing the channel to the glory of God, that they will hit over a million, and that he does not know whether they will see it on this side or the other.
mentions.quote: We'll hit over a million. I don't know
mentions.falsify_match: A million subscribers, publicly countable.
mentions.falsify_miss: Short of a million. The or the other side clause removes any deadline.

mentions.claim_text: He acknowledges that symptoms come and people die and that he has seen it, says he tried to take hold of it that way for his daughter Megan, that he is walking it out like everybody else, and that he refuses to accept what he calls the package.
mentions.quote: Symptoms come and people die. I understand that. I've seen it
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, but unusually candid: he concedes the healing teaching does not always hold, and names his own family as the case.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says 2026 is a very significant year and so are 2027 and 2028, three of them, and recalls the three coming down the mountain, saying the three is purple and is coming down the mountain.
mentions.quote: The three coming down the mountain is purple
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a colour and a number with no referent.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says he is up to thirty seven thousand and they are believing for a hundred thousand, and that he feels he has two foundations to lay in 2026 for what is coming in 2027 and 2028, which they must work on for the whole year.
mentions.quote: I have two foundations in 2026 for what's coming in 2027, 2028
mentions.falsify_match: A countable membership figure reaching 100,000.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. What the two foundations are is not stated.

mentions.claim_text: He recalls the Holy Spirit saying a few nights ago that after this comes there will be more gun laws, they will push more and take away even more freedoms, and that it will come even to social media.
mentions.quote: there'll be more gun laws, they'll push more, and they'll take away even more freedoms
mentions.falsify_match: New firearms restrictions followed by social media restrictions.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither. The standard legislative response to a shooting, forecast after one.

mentions.claim_text: He describes a press with fresh olive oil coming out of it, and says that is where he warned them what the Holy Spirit was saying, to get prepared, a shaking to a waking.
mentions.quote: a press and it was all of a fresh olive oil was coming out
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: the crushing that yields the oil, which is the shaking-to-waking image in another form.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says the Sugar Bowl is on January the 1st or 2nd and that the Lord said to pray first for that whole area, interceding for protection over the people of New Orleans.
mentions.quote: pray for all that area for intercession for protection over the people of New Orleans
mentions.falsify_match: An incident around the Sugar Bowl in New Orleans.
mentions.falsify_miss: None, credited to the prayer. A real attack happened in New Orleans on 1 January 2025, a year before, which is the obvious prompt for the target.

mentions.claim_text: He says that is what he saw to pray over for Christmas Eve next week, next Wednesday night, praying over midnight Christmas mass and Christmas mass with the Pope, and names Salt Lake City, confirming Salt Lake City is in Utah.
mentions.quote: Praying over Christmas mass with the Pope. It's Salt Lake City
mentions.falsify_match: An incident at a Christmas mass or in Salt Lake City on Christmas Eve.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Two unrelated places named in one breath, which makes either a possible match.

mentions.claim_text: He says the economy will be booming, interest rates going better and everything happening in 2026, and repeats that he told them the president will stimulate and it will be a shallow wave, with everything looking really good.
mentions.quote: he will stimulate and it will be a shallow wave
mentions.falsify_match: A stimulus-driven recovery in 2026 that does not hold.
mentions.falsify_miss: A durable recovery, or no recovery at all. Shallow wave is the useful hedge: good numbers confirm the wave, bad ones confirm the shallowness.

mentions.claim_text: He says that when you are expecting it, it is the surprise to open your eyes, that they are looking for the great implementation of it and watching for the right opportunity, and that when he spoke about the casing it said the alarm to do more harm.
mentions.quote: the surprise to open your eyes
mentions.falsify_match: An attack used as a pretext for measures already prepared.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Delivered in rhyming couplets with no place, date or actor attached.

mentions.claim_text: He says these are the signs of where they are and they are in dark hours, anticipates people saying they do not believe it, insists he is for being positive and believing God but tells them to look around, and dates it from September.
mentions.quote: we're in dark hours
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: dark hours has no measure.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says he keeps praying into it, wakes up and sees it, and has visions while driving around when he does not expect them, when the Lord will speak about 2026 and he will be looking in the spirit while driving down the road.
mentions.quote: I HAVE VISIONS WHEN I'M DRIVING AROUND AND I DON'T EVEN EXPECT IT
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an account of when the sights arrive.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says most people tell him they believe the rapture of the church is coming in 2026 and that they are out of here, answers that he prays they are right but believes they are wrong, and says he does not follow so and so but follows the Holy Ghost.
mentions.quote: I pray you're right. But I believe you're wrong
mentions.falsify_match: No rapture in 2026, which is what he expects.
mentions.falsify_miss: A rapture in 2026. A rare negative call, and it can fail.

mentions.claim_text: He says he can only say what he can say, that it is learning, gives glory to Jesus for his patience with him, and repeats that he feels like he is standing under a fire hydrant with all of it coming at once.
mentions.quote: I still feel like I'm standing underneath the fire hydrant
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and it doubles as an advance excuse for garbled or partial reporting.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says they will be here until then, that he knows what the Lord has said, which is prepare, and that he is preparing, describing being shown a storm and what is coming in 2026.
mentions.quote: I know what the Lord has said. Prepare
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an instruction, not an outcome.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says he wants so badly that none should perish, calls that none should perish but all come to repentance, and tells listeners they must repent of their sins and turn from their wicked ways because Jesus Christ is coming.
mentions.quote: I call that none should perish, but all come to repentance
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says 2026 is the beginning of all this and a major move, and reports being told that he is not coming back until at least North Korea has a chance, because there are forty two million people up there and he will not leave without giving them the opportunity.
mentions.quote: I'm not coming back until at least North Korea has a chance
mentions.falsify_match: The gospel reaching North Korea openly before the return.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not, but since the return has no date this cannot come due. It is also a precondition that pushes the return further out, against household-wont-taste-death.

mentions.claim_text: He says they are believing God for it in 2026 and having it written down and meditating on it, that he is believing God to give a certain amount of money away and to help with that amount as a ministry rather than hoarding it for himself.
mentions.quote: I'm believing God to give this amount of money away
mentions.falsify_match: A published giving figure for 2026.
mentions.falsify_miss: None published. The amount is not said aloud.

mentions.claim_text: He says it is all about Jesus to draw the people in, tells them to stretch belief for big, and prays that they would reach a million people for the kingdom of God and that they believe they receive it.
mentions.quote: we would reach a million people for the kingdom of God
mentions.falsify_match: A countable audience or convert figure of a million.
mentions.falsify_miss: It is not reached. No deadline is attached.

mentions.claim_text: He prays that at the beginning of 2027 they will say everything they put on that list came to pass and more, and that this will be an abundant year and a bountiful overflow year.
mentions.quote: everything I put on that list came to pass and more
mentions.falsify_match: The lists are private, so this can only be checked if he reports back on them.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He names Utah and the city, says there is obviously a temple there, that he is seeing a major temple, and that he is seeing an attack on this temple with certain things he sees about the attack.
mentions.quote: I'm seeing a major temple. And I'm seeing this attack on this temple
mentions.falsify_match: An attack on the Salt Lake temple.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. A named building in a named city, which is one of the more specific targets in the corpus, though no date is given.

mentions.claim_text: He says 2026 will be a year like they have never experienced before, a year like the body of Christ has never experienced before, prays in tongues, and says it is coming to a point and coming to a head.
mentions.quote: 2026, a year like the body of Christ has never experienced before
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: unlike anything before has no threshold, and it can be read onto whatever the year contains.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says it is the peak of this and everything is about to come, that the pressure has built and there is nothing more to hold it back so it is going to go, that the volcano is going, and that all these events will start happening like dominoes.
mentions.quote: the pressure's built and there's nothing more to hold back
mentions.falsify_match: A rapid sequence of major events.
mentions.falsify_miss: A quiet stretch. Dominoes and pressure are images, not thresholds.

mentions.claim_text: He says 2028 is very turbulent and he can see it right here, that 2027 is turbulent, and that 2026 brings a lot of change in a lot of areas and in a lot of people's lives, praying in tongues between the years.
mentions.quote: 2028 is very turbulent. I can see it
mentions.falsify_match: Turbulent years.
mentions.falsify_miss: Calm ones. Turbulence is never specified as financial, political or spiritual.

mentions.claim_text: He mentions the Christmas Eve mass with the Pope next week and says what is interesting is that the Lord keeps bringing up expecting the unexpected, and not to label it because you think it will happen at that time.
mentions.quote: Don't just label it because you're thinking it's going to happen that time
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable by construction: every date he names is pre-emptively released, so a quiet date is not a miss.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says this is when it is going to be, then corrects to expect the unexpected, mentions days at the football games rather than New Year's Eve, and asks when the Sugar Bowl is played before settling on January 1st.
mentions.quote: Like days at the football games. That's not New Year's Eve
mentions.falsify_match: An incident at a New Year bowl game.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. He moves the target off New Year's Eve and onto the football, which is the second date shift in the same thread.

mentions.claim_text: He calls it pivotal, like the scale, says the midterms are so important and that the American people must show up and vote to have a red wave, and that it is a pivotal year with many distractions.
mentions.quote: Midterms is so important. It's the scale
mentions.falsify_match: A Republican midterm win.
mentions.falsify_miss: A loss, which the prayer and turnout framing absorbs.

mentions.claim_text: He says it is in the vision, a targeted rate of two percent, that he saw two percent, recalls seeing the scale going up for housing and a new housing thing coming that would be transparent, and says it is not stable.
mentions.quote: Targeted rate 2%. I saw 2%
mentions.falsify_match: A two percent target rate, whether inflation or a mortgage programme, appearing in policy.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. A number this specific is rare here and it can be checked, though which rate is meant is left open.

mentions.claim_text: He says there are things they can stop and they have a lot of work to do this year, and admits he told Diana that part of him does not want to go into 2026 yet because he knows it is a lot of work.
mentions.quote: I really don't want to go into 2026 yet
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and another unguarded moment worth keeping alongside burden-of-seeing.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says 2026 is going to be a dandy, tells them to buckle up and be ready to pray because there is a lot of work to do, that it will be a year like they have never experienced before, and that they will remember him saying it.
mentions.quote: 2026 is going to be a dandy
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and you will remember me saying it is the tell: the claim is built to be recalled as a hit whatever happens.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a
